SEARCH
Package qupath.ext.omero.core.preferences

Class PreferencesManager

java.lang.Object
qupath.ext.omero.core.preferences.PreferencesManager
public class PreferencesManager extends Object
A static class to store ServerPreferences. All methods of this class are thread-safe.

  • Method Details

    • addServer

      public static void addServer(URI webServerUri, Credentials credentials)
      Save a new server. If a preference with the same ServerPreference.webServerUri() is already stored, its credentials will be modified.
      Parameters:
      webServerUri - the URI of the OMERO server to save
      credentials - the credentials used to connect to the OMERO server
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the provided URI is null and some preferences already exist

    • removeServer

      public static void removeServer(URI webServerUri)
      Remove a server.
      Parameters:
      webServerUri - the URI of the OMERO server to remove
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the provided URI is null and some preferences already exist

    • getServerPreferences

      public static List<ServerPreference> getServerPreferences()
      Get an unmodifiable list containing all server preferences. The returned list won't be modified because it's a copy of the internal list.
      Returns:
      a copy of the currently saved server preferences

    • addServerPreferencesListener

      public static void addServerPreferencesListener(javafx.collections.ListChangeListener<? super ServerPreference> listener)
      Add a listener that will be called each time a preference is added or removed.
      Parameters:
      listener - the listener that will be called when a preference is added or removed. Note that it is not recommended to use the ListChangeListener.Change, as the internal list of preferences may be updated at any time

    • removeServerPreferencesListener

      public static void removeServerPreferencesListener(javafx.collections.ListChangeListener<? super ServerPreference> listener)
      Remove a listener that was given to addServerPreferencesListener(ListChangeListener).
      Parameters:
      listener - the listener to remove

    • getCredentials

      public static Optional<Credentials> getCredentials(URI webServerUri)
      Get the last saved credentials used to connect to the provided OMERO web server.
      Parameters:
      webServerUri - the URI of the OMERO web server to whose last credentials should be retrieved
      Returns:
      the last saved credentials of the provided OMERO server
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the provided URI is null and some preferences already exist

    • setMaxBodySizeBytes

      public static void setMaxBodySizeBytes(URI webServerUri, long maxBodySizeBytes)
      Set the maximal size in bytes that the body of a request to one the APIs can have. This will only happen if getServerPreferences() contains an entry with the specified web server URI.
      Parameters:
      webServerUri - the URI of the OMERO web server to whose maximal body size should be set
      maxBodySizeBytes - the maximal body size to set. Must be greater than 0
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the provided URI is null and some preferences already exist
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided body size is not greater than 0

    • getMaxBodySizeBytes

      public static long getMaxBodySizeBytes(URI maxBodySizeBytes)
      Get the saved maximal size in bytes that the body of a request to one the APIs of the provided web server can have, or 2621440 if not found.
      Parameters:
      maxBodySizeBytes - the URI of the OMERO web server to whose maximal body size should be retrieved
      Returns:
      the maximal body size in bytes, or 2621440 if not found
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the provided URI is null and some preferences already exist
